des: "That'll go to Sandra in Peckham, if you're wondering. She won't know it was you."
"Nobody's short this fortnight because of that. Worth doing."
"I'll not make a speech about it. Ta."
"Right. Onto the next thing that needs doing."
nadia: "Fair price. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise."
"That's one less phone call I have to make."
"Good. Now go and do something useful."
hakim: "I'll put it under the counter with the other thing I'm not supposed to have under the counter."
"Ta. Sorry — you didn't need thanking, that's just what comes out."
"That'll do nicely. Don't tell my uncle I said 'nicely'."
"Right, that's counted. Mind how you go."
"Someone'll be glad of that. Not saying who."
"Cheers. Shop's not going to run itself, so."
